entries.description: Simple fallback Dockerfile for a Python backend service when no specialized framework (FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit) is detected. Base: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, copies source. Sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1. CMD: sh -c python main.py.
decision_rules: Fall back to this template only when no framework-specific Dockerfile exists
tradeoffs: Assumes main.py as entrypoint — must be updated if the entrypoint differs
No multi-stage build and no non-root user — extend for production hardening
anti_patterns: Do not use python:latest — always pin to a specific version (e.g. python:3.11-slim)
Do not copy source before installing requirements — always install deps first
